It also has full Manager Mode where you can start your own virtual football club, play various popular Leagues, win and take your club to the top, the unlimited amount of money or coins helps you to buy players from other clubs within the game.

There are popular football teams in the new FTS Mod PES 2022 Apk Obb such as Chelsea, Manchester United, Barcelona, Real Madrid, Newcastle all this teams can be found in popular Leagues such as La Liga, Premier League, Spanish League etc.

Game Modes such as Tournament, Quick Match, Start A Player Match and Manager mode can be played when you download the new FTS Mod PES 2022 edition game, just make sure you choose a football team with good player ratings.

Ability to change game difficulty level is also available in the new FTS mod PES, you change difficulty level from low, medium to high.

Full players transfers is up to date in the game, which means all players have been transferred to there current clubs,  just like in the real world of football.

Ability to customise your players is available in the game, whereby you can upload latest season FTS kits into the soccer game.

Game controls are working well and are very responsive when tapped on the screen, which means controling players won’t be difficult for you.
